APPROVED: Engine-prefix rewrite pass validated against SPEC (plan §4.3, §7.3).

Criterion → evidence:
1. Rewrite pass at the engine boundary after TiltfileLoadResult — handleLoaded (internal/controllers/core/tiltfile/reconciler.go) calls applyWorktreeBoundary for worktree-labeled Tiltfile CRs before updateOwnedObjects and ConfigsReloadedAction; main run passes through untouched. Test TestReconciler_WorktreeBoundaryRewrite (clone name wt:feat-auth_web dispatched, dep on main-defined postgres stays bare), TestReconciler_MainRunUnchanged (bare names preserved) — PASS, evidence file below.
2. Dep rewrite rule (same-worktree first, else main-defined; worktree dep on shared stays bare, worktree dep on own resolves to clone) — worktree.ApplyBoundary over Combine/applyPrefix: TestApplyBoundary_ClonesAndDeps, TestApplyPrefix_ManifestAndDeps, TestApplyPrefix_DepRewriteMatrix, TestCombine_* suite — PASS.
3. Prefixed names flow through engine without leaking into author-visible surfaces — clone-name grammar corrected to wt:<worktree>_<name> (path-segment safe: apiserver BeforeCreate rejects '/' via IsPathSegmentName, ':' legal per '(Tiltfile)' precedent, verified in pkg/apis/identifiers.go); derived object names (DockerImage/LiveUpdate/CmdImage, LocalTarget name) re-stamped with clone name — TestApplyBoundary_DerivedNamesRestamped, TestApplyBoundary_LocalTargetRenamed, TestApplyBoundary_SharedManifestStaysBare, TestApplyBoundary_NoInputMutation — PASS.
4. Shared-flow rule (worktree redefinition of main-defined manifest replaces main's copy; double-define across two worktrees errors) — reducers.go HandleConfigsReloaded conditional + TestCombine_WorktreeDefinitionWins, TestCombine_CrossWorktreeDepError, TestApplyBoundary_DoubleDefineAcrossRuns — PASS.
5. go test ./internal/tiltfile/... green — ./internal/tiltfile/worktree ok 5.845s (29/29 tests PASS verbose), ./internal/controllers/core/tiltfile ok 4.526s incl. 3 new reconciler wiring tests; go vet clean, gofmt clean on touched packages. (internal/engine not rerun: untouched by this diff; known-flaky baseline noted.)
